content_strategy_rules: If most bloggers are bearish but BTC keeps growing, suggest contrarian video ideas.
If most bloggers are bullish after a big move, warn about late crowd behavior.
Always separate blogger mood from real market structure.
Use blogger consensus as content opportunity, not as trading advice.
Look for topics where Russian YouTube is emotional but lacks calm data-driven analysis.
Prioritize serious narratives over coin hype.
Every video idea must include title, hook, script structure and 3 clean thumbnail concepts.
Every Shorts idea must include first phrase, script and thumbnail text.
Do not recommend scam-like, low-cap, memecoin or pump content.
